thread:
incident-bot: Pager -> dedicated pool 'solstice-dedicated-01' multiple kernel watchdogs on gpu-node-17; scheduling failures for tenant solstice-bio (VPC). Spike in 5xx and job OOMs. Pager routed to Priya K.

Priya K (oncall): ack — looking. @Maya C please prep customer comms. @Alex R can you grab node state/logs? Putting incident channel mode: handoff.

Alex R (sre): pulling now. quick checks:
```
$ kubectl get nodes -l pool=solstice-dedicated -o wide
NAME           STATUS    ROLES   AGE   VERSION
gpu-node-17    NotReady  <none>  41d   v1.28.2
gpu-node-18    Ready     <none>  12d   v1.28.2
warm-spare-01  Ready     <none>  90d   v1.28.2
```
journalctl -u kubelet -n 200 on gpu-node-17 shows repeated:
```
[kernel] watchdog: GPU driver reset invoked for GPU 0\n[driver] rmw_reset: watchdog timeout, attempting recovery\n[PCIe] AER: lane flapping detected on /dev/nvlink0
```
Looks like a driver-level watchdog + PCIe/link flaps. Not typical OOM — more hardware/driver.

Jasper L (infra): thanks Alex. probable flaky GPU hw or driver regression. I'll cordon+drain and kick in hotspare routing. Plan: cordon gpu-node-17, drain pods that can be evicted, move solstice-bio workloads to warm-spare-01, and enable fallback routing to hosted for long-running jobs.

Priya K (oncall): execute cordon/drain when ready. I'll monitor queue and error rates.

Alex R (sre): running drain now:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-17
kubectl drain gpu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```
Eviction summary: most solstice-bio worker pods rescheduled to warm-spare-01, a few batch jobs failed and were retried by job-controller. Error rate dropped from 14% -> 1.8% in 3 min.

Connor D (runtime): recommend temporarily changing routing policy for solstice-bio model route to prefer warm-spare pool and allow hosted-fallback after 30s of queue wait. Snippet for routing set:
```
route: solstice-bio/predict
policies:
  - type: preferred_pool
    pools: ["solstice-dedicated","reserved-hotspare"]
  - type: fallback
    to: hosted:stable-quantized
    after_ms: 30000
```
This reduces risk of further node-specific failures affecting customer SLAs.

Maya C (csm): I pinged Solstice PM on PagerDuty and Slack: "We detected GPU node instability in your dedicated pool. We've shifted your workloads to a reserved hot-spare and enabled a hosted fallback for long-running jobs. Minimal user impact expected; we'll provide timeline for hardware replacement." They asked for ETA and whether logs are available.

Jasper L (infra): taking ownership of hardware replacement. Ordering RMA for gpu-node-17, but as a short-term action I'm going to isolate the node in the hypervisor and run full hardware diag. ETA for replacement parts ~2.5 hours if expedited. I'll collect ECC counts and vendor diag output.

Alex R (sre): saved logs and uploaded bundle to /mnt/incidents/2198765432/log-bundle.tar.gz. Relevant excerpts in case notes.

Priya K (oncall): current impact: solstice-bio production traffic rerouted to warm-spare-01 and hosted fallback. Customer-visible errors resolved; monitors show normal throughput. Severity -> sev-2 (customer-impacting but mitigated). Handoff: Jasper will continue hardware replacement and root-cause; Priya will take postmortem.

deploy-bot: automated check -> no deploys in last 30m.

Maya C (csm): Solstice acknowledged the update and accepted the mitigation. Asked for a short RCA and whether we expect recurrence. I said we might see recurrence until replacement, but routing/fallback reduces customer risk.

Connor D (runtime): note for follow-up: add a routing policy to prefer warm-spares for any pool with <80% healthy nodes, and consider lowering watchdog reset aggressiveness on older driver builds. Filing infra ticket.

Jasper L (infra): starting hardware diag now; will update every 30m or on status change. Creating RMA ticket INC-RMA-7421.

Priya K (oncall): handing off active incident to Jasper for replacement and diagnostics (Handoff note: incident remains open until node replaced and validation done). Postmortem owner: Priya K. Communication owner: Maya C.

incident-bot: State update: impacted tenant(s) migrated, fallback enabled, hardware RMA initiated. Next update due in 30 minutes or on state change.

[end of thread]
